name: Iron Claws gives Rotclaw stacks, armor ignore and duration (#2166)
contract: Iron Claws 572783 has all three effects over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 512, 0) = word 1 bit 9 = the twelve Rotclaw records (503476-503486, 804197). Effect 0 is aura 107 with MiscValue 31 (SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS, consumed by SpellInfo::CalcMaxAuraStacks) and BasePoints 1 + DieSides 1 = +2; Rotclaw ships StackAmount 1, so it becomes 3. Effect 1 is aura 107 with MiscValue 23 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT3, which Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers maps to effect index 2) and BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = +3; Rotclaw's effect 2 is aura 338 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_IGNORE_ARMOR_PCT with amount 0, so it becomes 3, and AuraEffect::CalculateAmount multiplies by the stack amount. Effect 2 is aura 108 with MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION) and +50%; Rotclaw has DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms, so it becomes 6000 ms. Tooltip: "Allows Rotclaw's periodic effect to stack up $s1 additional times for $s3% longer duration and cause you to ignore $s2% of the target's armor." Regression guard for native behaviour.

steps.label: Rotclaw stacks once before the talent
Rotclaw's armor-ignore effect is zero before the talent
Rotclaw keeps its authored 4000 ms before the talent
Iron Claws lets Rotclaw stack three times
Iron Claws gives Rotclaw 3% armor ignore per stack
Iron Claws lengthens Rotclaw to 6000 ms
Iron Claws does not touch Bloodbolt's duration
